scope: Maximum allotments, not actual awards. Eligibility and net-income deductions are not evaluated here.
limitations: FY2026 tables list each-additional-person amounts without an 18+ cap; do not infer a statutory cap from omission.
Alaska urban/rural area membership must be researched before any locality consumes these rows.
Nutrition-assistance amounts for non-SNAP territories remain unresearched; absence from this file is not zero or noneligibility.
FY2027 caps and increments are independently published rounded amounts. They are preserved verbatim rather than recalculated from the rounded four- or eight-person allotments.
